cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a small hillside shrine — a red gate, stone lanterns, a purification basin and a path lined with ginkgo trees
cuts.scene: she is the chief shrine maiden standing before the red gate with her hands folded, calm and composed
cuts.outfit: a shrine maiden look fitted to her body — a white sleeveless kimono-style top with short red hakama culottes and tabi sandals, bare shoulders and legs, a sash hung with nine small gold bells
